text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly buying after prices fall can add risk without improving the investment case; I should set position limits and require a clear reason before adding.","Selling some holdings at a loss while continuing to add to another shows I need consistent criteria for every stock, based on its outlook and portfolio role—not recent price moves.","Because I trade infrequently, I should make a written plan for when to review each holding and what evidence would change my decision, rather than letting inaction or sudden price moves decide for me."]}
